captions: Open a lookup filter and search for the CIs you want to examine.
Select matching values. Values within a field combine with OR; different fields combine with AND.
scenes.title: Choose a starting item

captions: Show all matching results together in Impact Topology.
Select one result to return to a graph with a single starting CI.
scenes.title: Choose what the graph includes

captions: Use Business Impact to see the model relationships around the starting CI.
For a model, this view shows the higher-level context; member endpoints appear in Dependencies.
scenes.title: Choose Business Impact

captions: Switch to Dependencies to include recorded model dependencies and member endpoints.
Expand Relationship evidence to inspect each source, relationship, target and environment.
scenes.title: Choose Dependencies

captions: Select a graph node to read its details and connections.
Explore from this CI changes the starting point. Choose a layout and use Fit graph.
scenes.title: Inspect and navigate

captions: Generate Impact Report for the current mode and starting CI or group.
The report includes the full graph and evidence. Keep its scope, snapshot and starting point together.
scenes.title: Capture the result

captureMethod: Playwright screencast of the guide-launched practice lab; caption, pointer and focus overlays only.
